mapper.select: select sw.id, sw.warehouse_name as warehouseName, sw.warehouse_type as warehouseType, bui.name as keeper, sw.current_weight as currentWeight, sw.max_weight as maxWeight, sw.state, sw.remarks, sw.grain_variety as grainVariety, sw.grain_year as grainYear, sw.grain_grade as grainGrade, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and description = sw.grain_variety) as grainVarietyLabel, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_YEAR' and description = sw.grain_year) as grainYearLabel, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_GRADE' and description = CAST(sw.grain_grade AS VARCHAR)) as grainGradeLabel from sts_warehouse sw left join base_user_info bui on bui.id = sw.keeper where sw.id = #{id}

select sw.id, sw.warehouse_name as warehouseName, sw.warehouse_type as warehouseType, sw.grain_variety as grainVariety, sw.grain_year as grainYear, sw.grain_grade as grainGrade, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_VARIETY' and description = sw.grain_variety) as grainVarietyLabel, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_YEAR' and description = sw.grain_year) as grainYearLabel, (select label from base_dict_data where type = 'GRAIN_GRADE' and description = CAST(sw.grain_grade AS VARCHAR)) as grainGradeLabel from sts_warehouse sw
sw.state = 1 and sw.current_weight < sw.max_weight
and sw.grain_variety = #{grainVariety}
order by sw.add_time desc
